html: † זֹחֶ֫לֶת n.f. meaning dub.; perhaps crawling thing, serpent (WeSkizzen iii. 171 cites Arabic Zuḫal = Saturn, in connex. with 1 K 1:9; cf. Lane & Wetzst in De Hiob 2, 428 on view that Zuḫal = he who withdraws, because of planet Saturn’s remoteness)—only c. art., in design. loc. עִם אֶבֶן הַזֹּחֶלֶת 1 K 1:9 (cf. אֶבֶן ad fin.)
